name: Under Your Skin
source:
You think it's your lucky day when a Prototype Vocaldroid program named Veiss becomes yours. You can't wait to compose with his beautiful voice and get some new songs on your MothTube channel!

But soon, your music begins to change mysteriously. The lyrics become incredibly filthy and filled with declarations of desire...

And it turns out that... the supposed Vocaldroid you downloaded is a virus in disguise that wastes no time hacking your cybernetic braindrive!

His name is Veiss! He's irritating, snarky, a huge asshole and he wants all of you.

Even those horrid secrets you've been running from.

Just don't call him a virus. He really hates that.

[From [url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/under-your-skin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当名为Veiss的Prototype Vocaldroid程序成为你的时，你认为这是你的幸运日。你迫不及待地想用他美妙的声音作曲并在你的MothTube频道上获取一些新歌曲！

但很快，你的音乐开始发生神秘的变化。歌词变得极其肮脏，充满了欲望的宣言……

事实证明…你下载的所谓Vocaldroid是一种经过伪装的病毒，它会立即侵入你的控制论大脑驱动器！

他的名字叫维斯！他很烦人，脾气暴躁，是个大混蛋，他想要你们所有人。

即使是那些你一直在逃避的可怕秘密。

只是不要称他为病毒。他真的很讨厌这样。

[来自[url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/under-your-skin]itch.io[/url]]
